verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a package manager, and its Brewfile is documented as a per-project dependency manifest, so a monorepo-workspace question is a fair one to ask. However, the evidence shows only a single Brewfile per project repository. There is no documented support for workspaces across multiple packages, a shared lockfile, or cross-linked local dependencies, and Brewfile-in-repo alone does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage many packages in one monorepo with workspaces sharing a single lockfile and cross-linked local dependencies
